comparison.objective: Load a caulking gun and meter a continuous sealant bead along a bath joint; the candidate adjusts and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests holding a release while retracting a rod, seating a cartridge, operating a trigger, and guiding a nozzle while metering material. Candidate tests hex-key insertion, bounded setscrew torque, fine collar rotation, and repeated impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a loaded gun and at least 95% joint coverage with no gap over 2 mm in its mature specs. Candidate requires two safe stops within a 12 mm damper stroke and no setting drift after relocking.
comparison.reason: Although both manipulate a release/retention mechanism and make an adjustment, one tests tool loading and controlled dispensing while the other tests dynamic-response commissioning. Candidate does not numerically define permitted drift, rebound, or overload.
